name: Gradient Descent Solver
definition: A matrix-free gradient descent solver supporting constant update rate $\alpha$ or the Adam optimizer, stable for ill-conditioned systems.
summary: The Gradient Descent Solver is a matrix-free optimization method that updates voxel grid parameters in differentiable volume rendering by minimizing loss via first-order gradients, distinguishing itself by supporting constant rates or the Adam optimizer without explicitly forming the Hessian.
